title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Yuvraj Vijay Singh, replaces him just before Vijay is to be crowned king. Although Vijay is engaged to Princess Maithili, she falls in love with Prem.

title: Loveyatri
desc: Sushrut who runs a Garba academy falls in love with a beautiful NRI, Michelle, but her father creates a rift between the two. However, Sushrut is determined to win her back.

title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.

title: Snake
desc: A young farm girl, ensnared by a sinister stranger's lies, must wield the truth to rescue her family from impending danger.

title: Bhai Mera Big Brother
desc: A hitman turns against his boss and decide to help an undercover police officer when he learns about his real identity.

title: Heartless
desc: When Aditya experiences anaesthesia awareness during his heart transplant surgery, he finds out the dirty ploy of his childhood friend Dr Suman and his wife Ria to kill him.

title: Police Power
desc: A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.

title: Masss
desc: After a life-threatening accident, a man finds that he can communicate with the dead, and must decide whether to act on their advice.

title: Surya The Soldier
desc: When a soldier lands in trouble due to his anger issues, he begins seeing a psychologist in hopes of one day returning to duty.

title: Jawaan
desc: Azad fights against the systemic oppression of society. Soon, he finds himself in a web of deceit and crime as he teams up with a group of allies to take down a ruthless arms dealer.

title: Hero The Bullet
desc: Shiva, a young man, is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
desc: Forest officer Prajapati Pandey faces the heat when his wife, Aparna, catches him in suspicious situations with Chanchal and Nilofer.

title: Big Dhamaka
desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. However, despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.
